record_form: Structured synthesis of completed independent reports retained in the continuation checkpoint; not verbatim transcripts
review_boundary: Read-only review. No reviewer launched an experiment, allocated scientific data, changed a registry, or granted learner authority.

reviews.scope: Inherited R32/AJ boundaries and R33 architecture, ownership, observability and first-audit design
reviews.strongest_criticism: White-box intent is not enforced: trace_emit silently drops at 8192 and some wrappers mutate before recording. Score-based Foundry acceptance is not human-granted authority.
reviews.missing_experiment: Full-parent/migration manifest, durable fail-closed mutation trace and external authority tests; first isolate five bounded prototype helper witnesses without training.
reviews.confound: Engineered sensory invariances and inherited controller competence could be miscredited as learner-owned raw perception; prototype helpers are not the active AJ entrypoint.
reviews.falsification_test: Trace capacity plus one, raw-distinct but transformed-identical inputs, protected-memory pressure, incomplete reload and unauthenticated promotion must reveal the claimed boundary failure or reject the claim.
reviews.recommended_change: Separate raw and invariant paths, enforce transactional trace and external authority, inventory complete parent state, distinguish human trainers from automated Master aids, and preserve the active graph-free constraint.
reviews.what_not_to_claim: No full continuity, comprehensive transparency, natural sensory readiness, Foundry autonomy, architecture superiority or consciousness. Fixed-family scaling precedes preservation execution under the human priority order.
reviews.disposition: Accepted as scope/gate corrections. Required mechanisms remain unimplemented qualification blockers, not completed capabilities.

reviews.scope: E51AJ reconciliation, E51N/AD antecedents, scaling, longitudinal preservation, telemetry and first nontraining batch
reviews.strongest_criticism: A moving preservation reference permits cumulative deterioration, while frozen-parent alone cannot distinguish a better learning rule from merely accepting fewer updates.
reviews.missing_experiment: Reduced-dose or independently randomly thinned ordinary-update controls, frozen original-reference constraints, and retention/gain curves against accepted updates and measured compute.
reviews.confound: Identical proposed updates cease to be well-defined after branches reject different updates; presentations, visited states, proposals, accepted updates and compute are different quantities.
reviews.falsification_test: Reject the remedy when training constraints pass without fresh retention gains, useful learning disappears, thinning controls explain the benefit, or wrong commitments/failed UNKNOWN buy retention.
reviews.recommended_change: Use explicitly adaptive branch-local proposals for the primary contrast, freeze original checkpoint/ranking/tolerance/progress references, record rejected optimizer/RNG/memory state and checking cost, and preserve all final/ever-lost/worst-loss metrics.
reviews.what_not_to_claim: No replay cure, unseen-state guarantee, monotone scaling, necessity of a new architecture, working dashboard, or assistance-stage qualification. Five-witness audit first; fixed-family scaling before preservation execution.
reviews.disposition: Accepted. Integrated into preservation, scaling and telemetry specifications; numeric B003 thresholds and schedules remain unallocated until its own preregistration.

reviews.scope: Prototype authority/trace/memory helpers and milestone/rollback design; initial review preceded completed R33 registries and audit-scope files
reviews.strongest_criticism: Rollback must not rewind supervisor revocations, nonces, spent budgets or failure history; permission rechecking alone does not make authorization and commit atomic.
reviews.missing_experiment: Crash-boundary recovery, concurrent revocation/version changes, exhausted audit/recovery reserve, shadow writable-alias checks, descendant budget aggregation and replayed-grant tests.
reviews.confound: Prototype defects are not automatically AJ defects: named trace_emit, protected-LRU and sensory helpers were absent from the inspected assembled AJ source and retained imported core. Hash identity is not a signature or authorization.
reviews.falsification_test: Attempt rollback-based grant revival/refund, candidate or dependency substitution, parent-version race, recursive quota escape, and mutation without durable audit/recovery reserve; every attempt must be denied or leave a durable failed transaction.
reviews.recommended_change: Serialized supervisor authorization/commit binds instance, branch, scope, operation, dependency/candidate hashes, parent version, policy epoch, reserved quota and nonce. Isolate shadow state and preserve non-rewindable history.
reviews.what_not_to_claim: No deployed isolation, signed checkpoint, M0-M7 grant, sensory qualification, comprehensive AJ defect attribution, or capability gain from reproducing a prototype failure.
reviews.disposition: Accepted. Safety clauses integrated; runtime enforcement remains unverified. Support applies to diagnostic five-witness audit design, not a scientific qualification grant.

infrastructure_attempts.failure: Repeated ChatGPT Web five-browser-turn concurrency limit; dispatch/resume did not produce a completed verdict
